intro: Maggran's Reserve Letter is an official dispatch written by Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat. Carried across Kalimdor to the Great Lift, it grants a stationed sentry long-awaited relief so he may return home to visit his family.

p: Maintaining outposts across the rugged expanse of Kalimdor demands vigilance, but the leaders of the Horde recognize that prolonged watch duty takes a heavy toll on morale. Penned by Maggran Earthbinder in the high crags of Sun Rock Retreat, this simple missive serves as official orders notifying Grish Longrunner that a replacement warrior has been dispatched to take over his post at the Great Lift. For a lonely guard watching over the towering wooden winches far to the south, the letter promises something rare in troubled times: an honorable leave of absence to reunite with family.
